currency.basis: The flat one-color #003087 outline monogram is PayPal's current monogram variant of the 2024-2025 brand refresh; observed live on official PayPal properties on 2026-10-03. The accepted icon is the older filled two-tone monogram variant in a circle with non-official #183686 fill.

identity.basis: The double-P monogram is PayPal's own mark, served from PayPal's official CDN (paypalobjects.com) and consistent with the official site's declared logo assets.

assessment.independenceRationale: Both observations come from PayPal's own properties (paypal.com homepage and developer.paypal.com) plus the official CDN asset itself; they are one official provenance group, which is sufficient because identity and currency of a current operating brand rest on official use.
uncertainties: No official press/brand-kit bundle page was located; the monogram URL was verified by successful live fetch from the official CDN.
A two-tone filled monogram variant, if still used officially anywhere, was not located; the located official monogram is the flat outline style.

variant.basis: Standalone double-P monogram without accompanying text; suitable as a standalone catalog mark. The wordmark variant (black 'PayPal' text) was rejected for catalog use because of the accompanying name.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Outline monogram paths, single #003087 fill and transparency identical between the source and final in source/final comparison on both themes; no detail loss.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Standalone mark on transparency, source proportions preserved, no backing added, no transform beyond none; complete fit at 240px with even margins, recognizable at 32px on both themes. Disclosed limitation: the flat dark-blue #003087 mark has reduced contrast on the dark theme background, inherent to the official one-color variant; no recoloring is permitted.
candidate.rationale: Documented rebrand update: the accepted icon is the superseded filled two-tone monogram in a dark circle with non-official #183686 fill; PayPal's current brand uses this flat one-color #003087 outline monogram, retrieved from the official CDN.
candidate.role: catalog standalone brand mark on transparency
transforms: No geometry transformation: official monogram SVG used as fetched (viewBox 0 0 48 48, flat #003087).

SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen worktree svgo.config.mjs (sha256 f2a406e0...), multipass: 2443 -> 2381 bytes; optimized version selected (visually identical to working version at 240px on both themes, confirmed by model image comparison of rsvg-convert renders).
candidate.variant: official flat one-color outline double-P monogram (2024-2025 brand refresh)
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Accepted icon is a filled two-tone white/blue monogram in a dark circle; candidate is the current flat outline monogram without backing — visibly different variant and presentation.

proposals.reason: Accepted icon (sha256 dc7a58d5...) is the superseded 2014-era two-tone filled PP monogram in a dark-blue circle using non-official fill #183686. PayPal's current brand (2024-2025 refresh) uses a flat one-color #003087 outline double-P monogram; an official original-vector monogram was retrieved from the official PayPal CDN and is proposed as a candidate replacement.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official original-vector monogram of PayPal's current brand variant, retrieved live from the official PayPal CDN; supports a rebrand/color-corrected update over the superseded filled monogram in the accepted icon.

sources.observation: Official homepage JSON-LD declares the current site logo as the official paypalobjects.com SVG wordmark of the 2024 PayPal Pro typeface refresh; the same official CDN hosts the flat #003087 outline monogram retrieved as the candidate. Raster monogram pp32.png on the same CDN was noted as research-only, not a vector candidate.
Official developer icon listing hosts SVGs on paypalobjects.com; PayPal's own monogram is not listed there, but confirms paypalobjects.com as PayPal's official SVG asset host.
